dotnet-agents
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Command                             Purpose                                                                             
dotnet agents                       List bundled orchestration agents and show the current install target.              
dotnet agents help                  Render the direct command reference for the agent-only tool.                        
dotnet agents list                  List available orchestration agents.                                                
dotnet agents install router ai     Install one or more orchestration agents by name.                                   
dotnet agents install --all --auto  Install all agents to every detected native agent directory.                        
dotnet agents remove router         Remove one or more installed orchestration agents.                                  
dotnet agents where --agent codex   Print the resolved native agent install path.                                       
dotnet agents version               Show the current `dotnet-agents` version and check whether NuGet has a newer rele...

╭ notes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│- `dotnet agents` is the dedicated agent-only CLI. It does not install skills.                                     │
│- Use `dotnet skills ...` when you want catalog skills or bundle installs.                                         │
│- `dotnet agents list` and bare `dotnet agents` both show the bundled agent catalog.                               │
│- `dotnet agents version` and `dotnet agents --version` both show the current tool version.                        │
│- Set `DOTNET_AGENTS_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to suppress automatic tool update notices on startup.                    │
│- Agent auto-detect uses only native agent roots. If none exist yet, specify `--agent` or `--target`.            
[truncated]
